title: Britain celebrates 200-year anniversary of passenger trains
titleChinese: 英国庆祝第一列旅客列车通车 200 周年
paragraphs: "The railway that got the world on track." On the 27 September 1825, crowds gathered in a small market town in north-east England to witness something that had not been seen before – a train carrying passengers for the first time. It had taken eight hours to travel 48km – around the speed of an average cyclist – but this steam locomotive was a pioneer in the development of modern railways and changed the world forever as rail spread across the globe.

2025 marks 200 years of passenger trains, and the UK is celebrating this milestone with Railway 200 – a year-long programme of events. From guided walking tours along old, abandoned rail routes, to competitions and careers events. Railway 200 organisers have also designed a travelling exhibition on a special train that will criss-cross the UK for 12 months. Admission to the train is free and there are four carriages, each with a different theme. These include a carriage with hands-on, interactive activities which invite people to test their engineering skills. Emma Roberts, Railway 200 organiser, said it is an "unforgettable experience" for visitors.

Also celebrating this bicentennial is Tom Chesshyre, train enthusiast and author of 'Slow Trains Around Britain'. Among what attracts him to train travel is that you can see places off the beaten track out the train window, and you can relax and read a book without worrying about traffic jams. Tom's favourite slow train ride is from Inverness, in the middle of Scotland, to the most northerly station in the whole of the UK in Thurso through "a kind of desolate landscape". Tom says, "You feel like you're taking a train and disappearing from modern life, leaving it behind."

The route Tom crowned 'most picturesque' was a short journey from St Erth in Cornwall to St Ives which travels along a clifftop with the beach down below. Train travel has come a long way since 1825. Today, trains are more efficient and better connected than ever. From the Eurostar, which connects London to mainland Europe through a tunnel under the English Channel, to high-speed routes in Japan and China, the world is on the move.

vocabulary.entry: **on track** /ɒn ˈtræk/ phr. 走上正轨，按计划进行（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The project is finally back on track after the delays.
vocabulary.translation: 经过延误后，项目终于重新步入正轨。

vocabulary.entry: **crowd** /kraʊd/ n. 人群
vocabulary.example: A large crowd gathered to watch the game.
vocabulary.translation: 一大群人聚拢来看比赛。

vocabulary.entry: **witness** /ˈwɪtnəs/ v. 见证，目睹（书面语）
vocabulary.example: We witnessed a beautiful sunset over the mountains.
vocabulary.translation: 我们目睹了山峦上美丽的日落。

vocabulary.entry: **passenger** /ˈpæsɪndʒə(r)/ n. 乘客
vocabulary.example: The train was full of passengers.
vocabulary.translation: 火车上挤满了乘客。

vocabulary.entry: **locomotive** /ˌləʊkəˈməʊtɪv/ n. 火车头，机车（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The steam locomotive pulled a long line of carriages.
vocabulary.translation: 蒸汽机车拉着长长的车厢。

vocabulary.entry: **pioneer** /ˌpaɪəˈnɪə(r)/ n. 先驱，开拓者（书面语）
vocabulary.example: He was a pioneer in the field of space exploration.
vocabulary.translation: 他是太空探索领域的先驱。

vocabulary.entry: **milestone** /ˈmaɪlstəʊn/ n. 里程碑，重要事件（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Graduating from university is a major milestone in life.
vocabulary.translation: 大学毕业是人生中的一个重要里程碑。

vocabulary.entry: **abandoned** /əˈbændənd/ adj. 被遗弃的，废弃的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The children played in the abandoned building.
vocabulary.translation: 孩子们在被废弃的大楼里玩耍。

vocabulary.entry: **route** /ruːt/ n. 路线，线路
vocabulary.example: We took the scenic route through the mountains.
vocabulary.translation: 我们选择了穿过山区的风景路线。

vocabulary.entry: **criss-cross** /ˈkrɪs krɒs/ v. 纵横交错，来回穿梭
vocabulary.example: Buses criss-cross the city throughout the day.
vocabulary.translation: 公交车全天在城市中穿梭。

vocabulary.entry: **admission** /ədˈmɪʃn/ n. 入场费，进入许可（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
vocabulary.translation: 博物馆周日免费入场。

vocabulary.entry: **carriage** /ˈkærɪdʒ/ n. （火车）车厢（英式）
vocabulary.example: The last carriage was almost empty.
vocabulary.translation: 最后一节车厢几乎是空的。

vocabulary.entry: **hands-on** /ˌhændz ˈɒn/ adj. 动手实践的，亲自动手的（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The course includes hands-on training in the laboratory.
vocabulary.translation: 这门课程包括实验室的动手实践培训。

vocabulary.entry: **interactive** /ˌɪntərˈæktɪv/ adj. 互动的，交互的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The museum has many interactive exhibits.
vocabulary.translation: 这个博物馆有许多互动展品。

vocabulary.entry: **unforgettable** /ˌʌnfəˈɡetəbl/ adj. 难忘的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The trip to Paris was an unforgettable experience.
vocabulary.translation: 巴黎之旅是一次难忘的经历。

vocabulary.entry: **bicentennial** /ˌbaɪsenˈteniəl/ n. 两百周年纪念（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The city is preparing for the bicentennial of its founding.
vocabulary.translation: 该市正在筹备建城两百周年纪念。

vocabulary.entry: **enthusiast** /ɪnˈθjuːziæst/ n. 热衷者，爱好者（书面语）

vocabulary.translation: 我们堵车堵了两个小时。

vocabulary.example: The landscape was desolate and barren.
vocabulary.translation: 这片土地荒凉贫瘠。

vocabulary.entry: **crown** /kraʊn/ v. 为……加冕，授予（书面语）
vocabulary.example: He was crowned world champion for the second time.
vocabulary.translation: 他第二次被加冕为世界冠军。

vocabulary.entry: **picturesque** /ˌpɪktʃəˈresk/ adj. 风景如画的， picturesque（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The village is set in picturesque surroundings.
vocabulary.translation: 村庄坐落在风景如画的环境中。

vocabulary.entry: **clifftop** /ˈklɪftɒp/ n. 悬崖顶端
vocabulary.example: We stood on the clifftop watching the waves below.
vocabulary.translation: 我们站在悬崖顶上看着下面的海浪。

vocabulary.example: Technology has come a long way in the past twenty years.
vocabulary.translation: 科技在过去二十年中取得了长足的进步。

vocabulary.entry: **efficient** /ɪˈfɪʃnt/ adj. 高效的，有效率的
vocabulary.example: The new system is much more efficient than the old one.
vocabulary.translation: 新系统比旧系统高效得多。

vocabulary.entry: **Eurostar** /ˈjʊərəʊstɑː(r)/ n. 欧洲之星（列车服务）

vocabulary.translation: 欧洲之星只需两个多小时就能把你从伦敦送到巴黎。

vocabulary.entry: **high-speed** /ˌhaɪ ˈspiːd/ adj. 高速的
vocabulary.example: Japan is famous for its high-speed bullet trains.
vocabulary.translation: 日本以其高速子弹头列车而闻名。

vocabulary.entry: **on the move** /ɒn ðə ˈmuːv/ phr. 在移动中，在进展中（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The army was on the move at dawn.
vocabulary.translation: 军队在黎明时分开始移动。

sentences.english: "The railway that got the world on track."
On the 27 September 1825, crowds gathered in a small market town in north-east England to witness something that had not been seen before – a train carrying passengers for the first time.
sentences.chinese: 1825年9月27日，人群聚集在英格兰东北部的一座小型集镇，见证了前所未有的创举——一列火车首次搭载乘客出行。

sentences.english: It had taken eight hours to travel 48km – around the speed of an average cyclist – but this steam locomotive was a pioneer in the development of modern railways and changed the world forever as rail spread across the globe.
sentences.chinese: 它耗时8小时行驶48公里，时速与普通骑行者大致相当，但这台蒸汽机车是现代铁路发展的先驱，随着铁路在全球范围内普及，它永久地改变了世界。

sentences.english: 2025 marks 200 years of passenger trains, and the UK is celebrating this milestone with Railway 200 – a year-long programme of events.
sentences.chinese: 2025年是客运列车问世200周年，英国正通过“铁路200”系列活动庆祝这一里程碑，这是一项为期一整年的活动计划。

sentences.english: From guided walking tours along old, abandoned rail routes, to competitions and careers events.
sentences.chinese: 活动包括沿老旧废弃铁路线开展的有向导徒步游览、各类竞赛以及职业招聘会。

sentences.english: Railway 200 organisers have also designed a travelling exhibition on a special train that will criss-cross the UK for 12 months.
sentences.chinese: “铁路200”的组织者还在一列专列上设计了巡回展览，这列火车将在英国全境穿梭行驶12个月。

sentences.english: Admission to the train is free and there are four carriages, each with a different theme.
sentences.chinese: 列车免费参观，共设有四节车厢，每节车厢主题各不相同。

sentences.english: These include a carriage with hands-on, interactive activities which invite people to test their engineering skills.
sentences.chinese: 其中一节车厢设有亲身体验的互动活动，邀请人们测试自身的工程技能。

sentences.english: Emma Roberts, Railway 200 organiser, said it is an "unforgettable experience" for visitors.
sentences.chinese: “铁路200”的组织者艾玛·罗伯茨表示，这对游客而言是一场“难忘的体验”。

sentences.english: Also celebrating this bicentennial is Tom Chesshyre, train enthusiast and author of 'Slow Trains Around Britain'.
sentences.chinese: 同样在庆祝这二百周年纪念的还有汤姆·切希尔，他是火车爱好者，也是《环英慢火车之旅》一书的作者。

sentences.english: Among what attracts him to train travel is that you can see places off the beaten track out the train window, and you can relax and read a book without worrying about traffic jams.
sentences.chinese: 火车旅行吸引他的一点在于，能透过车窗看到人迹罕至的地方，还能放松身心阅读书籍，无需担心交通拥堵。

sentences.english: Tom's favourite slow train ride is from Inverness, in the middle of Scotland, to the most northerly station in the whole of the UK in Thurso through "a kind of desolate landscape".
sentences.chinese: 汤姆最喜爱的慢火车线路是从苏格兰中部的因弗内斯，前往英国全境最北端的瑟索车站，沿途会经过“一片荒凉的景致”。

sentences.english: Tom says, "You feel like you're taking a train and disappearing from modern life, leaving it behind."
sentences.chinese: 汤姆说：“你会感觉自己乘着火车，远离了现代生活。”

sentences.english: The route Tom crowned 'most picturesque' was a short journey from St Erth in Cornwall to St Ives which travels along a clifftop with the beach down below.
sentences.chinese: 被汤姆誉为“风景最美”的线路，是从康沃尔郡的圣埃尔赫到圣艾夫斯的短途旅程，列车沿着悬崖顶端行驶，下方就是海滩。

sentences.english: Train travel has come a long way since 1825.
sentences.chinese: 自1825年以来，火车旅行已然取得了长足发展。

sentences.english: Today, trains are more efficient and better connected than ever.
sentences.chinese: 如今，火车比以往任何时候都更高效、连通性也更好。

sentences.english: From the Eurostar, which connects London to mainland Europe through a tunnel under the English Channel, to high-speed routes in Japan and China, the world is on the move.
sentences.chinese: 从穿过英吉利海峡海底隧道，连接伦敦与欧洲大陆的欧洲之星列车，到日本、中国的高铁线路，整个世界都在飞速运转。
